commit_scope: Production was down ten hours (07:15–09:21 UTC): the API process died at import because anonymous_meeting_trace_service asked the kernel for its BML query while the module loaded, and inside the b9527a577 image that run failed (BML contract source unavailable: form/form-stdlib/core.fk). Production was rolled back by hand to 26057a5e3 and breathes; the query is now read on first use, so one recipe's staging cannot take every route down.
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-20 17:1x WITA: https://api.coherencycoin.com/api/health answered a Traefik `404 page not found`; on the VPS coherence-network-api-1 was `Restarting (1)` with 119 restarts since 07:16 UTC, image revision b9527a577; the Hostinger Auto Deploy run 39384013694 had ended `FAIL: API did not remain locally and publicly stable after one bounded repair` and no later deploy ran. Nothing had moved for ten hours.

The container's log: ImportError chain from app/main.py → app.routers.meetings → app.services.anonymous_meeting_trace_service line 18 `_ANONYMOUS_TRACE_QUERY, _ = serve_text_via_kernel("anonymous_trace_query.bml", {})` → form_kernel_bridge._run_staged_source → `RuntimeError: fkwu failed (exit 2): … BML contract source unavailable: form/form-stdlib/core.fk`. The import-time call was introduced by #4082 (2026-10-19); the image layout it died on came with #4117 (962549a32, 2026-10-20), which nests the stdlib at /app/form/form/form-stdlib and no longer provides /app/form/form-stdlib.

Restored at 09:20 UTC: `bash /docker/coherence-network/auto-deploy.sh 26057a5e3…` (the last revision whose rollout verified) — api `Up (healthy)`, edge /api/health 200 at 09:21:40Z. The native-api, pulse and web containers came back with it.

The heal here: the trace query is read once, on first use (functools.lru_cache), and a failure to serve it stays the trace route's own error with the kernel's words intact. The API imports; api/tests/test_anonymous_meeting_traces.py, test_graph_layer.py and test_agent_task_claims.py: 20 passed. A grep of api/app finds no other module-level kernel call.

Why the kernel refuses the prelude inside that image is being reproduced in a probe build of b9527a577 on the VPS (tag probe-b95, not deployed) and is the next commit; locally the image-shaped layout resolves the prelude from /app/form, writable or read-only, so the remaining cause lives in what the real image holds.

Main also no longer serves /api/health from the Python host (#4117 moved health to the native container, Traefik native-api router priority 300 over coherence-api 100); /api/ping remains Python-served and is the public endpoint named here.
